stops.text: Almost empty room. Three or four objects, each one chosen.
A lived in amount of stuff. Surfaces have things on them, none of it staged.
Busy. Every surface occupied, small stories in the background, but the figures still read first.
Drowning in objects. The people are found rather than seen. Every corner has a joke in it.
Proportions as observed. Expression carried by small things: a hand, an eyebrow, a lean.
Gently pushed. Expressions a notch bigger than life, bodies still plausible.
Caricature. Heads and hands larger, limbs elastic, faces doing more than faces can.
Full cartoon physics. Rubber limbs, motion smears, eyes leaving sockets if the moment earns it.
Two colours only, plus the paper. Everything mixed from those.
Three or four flat colours, no tints beyond them.
A limited palette of about {v} colours. Still visibly restricted.
Full colour, but matte and hand made, never a gradient.
Hairline outline or none. Shapes hold the drawing.
A medium line that thickens on the shadow side and thins on the light.
Heavy confident line, brush or thick pen, colour sitting loosely inside it.
Massive line, almost woodcut, colour reduced to fills between black.
Very close. Faces and hands fill the frame, edges of people cut off.
Conversational distance. Whole upper bodies, some room around them.
Full figures with floor and ceiling, the room as a character.
Far back. The people are small in a large space, and the space says as much as they do.
